podcast.body: This trilogy of rap albums was released in a single year (2017) and was deemed "super interesting" and "fantastic," with all three being of high quality. The trilogy was considered "unorthodox" within rap, showcasing significant differences in the flows and styles of its many members, setting it apart from other large rap groups like Wu-Tang Clan or projects involving Eminem. "hacer tres discos de rap en un año y hacer todos así de buenos con tan distintos los flows de todos ellos están súper bien."

srcs.episode: Discos que los subsciptores echasteis en falta en la lista de lo mejor del año y tenéis razón
